instruction: Visit gnome-look.org to download and install the Papirus icon theme, and apply it as your system's icon theme.

metadata.explanation: This variation requires installing and activating the Papirus icon theme from gnome-look.org. The evaluator checks the icon-theme setting using gsettings. Similar difficulty to original task. Verified that gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface icon-theme returns the active icon theme name.

llm_judge_reasons: Correct state extraction: Uses 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface icon-theme' which is the correct command to verify the active GNOME icon theme
Appropriate postconfig: Executes gsettings command to capture system icon theme state after task completion

Complete coverage: Verifies the final outcome (icon theme is set) which is the goal of the instruction. Intermediate steps (downloading from gnome-look.org, installing) are means to achieve this end state.
